whoItsFor: Developers who want an open-source coding agent for the terminal that can use hosted or local models of their choice, with approvals and a record of every file change and command.
useCases: Fix failing tests in a project and explain what changed
Run one headless coding task from a script or CI job with `codewhale exec`
Get an advisory review of a pull request with `codewhale review --pr N`
